title: Waymo's First Self-Designed Ride-Hailing Vehicle Ojai Unveiled: Gemini in Waymo On Board, Three Screens Have Different Roles

content_html:
Waymo, the autonomous driving company under Google, has launched its first self-driving car designed from scratch for ride-hailing scenarios, called Ojai. It also introduced the in-car AI assistant Gemini in Waymo and a completely renewed three-screen interface. Waymo aims to turn the cabin into a flexible space that passengers can use independently, and will soon invite more members of the public to experience it.

Gemini is on board but does not hold the steering wheel, voice interaction covers the cabin

The Gemini in Waymo conversational AI assistant installed inside the Ojai runs independently from the Waymo Driver driving system. After passengers click on the Gemini icon on the screen, they can adjust the air conditioning temperature, view trip information, ask about nearby coffee shops or landmark histories, and even directly control the cabin by saying "set the air conditioning to 18 degrees Celsius." Passengers can also request to pull over by voice, but Waymo clearly states that Gemini does not control vehicle movement or route, nor can it access real-time driving data.

This screen update is the first major interface change Waymo has made in years. The new interface highlights trip information, music control, and cabin media settings. The Ojai features three screens, and the system displays different content based on the seat—passengers sitting alone in the rear right seat can access full control options, while other screens display simplified trip status or ambient media players. It also offers Calm Mode, which dims the screen to keep only the minimum trip information. From custom hardware to AI cabin to scenario-based interaction, Waymo is trying to redefine what it means to "ride in a car"—handing the steering wheel over to algorithms and returning the rest of the space to passengers.

content_html_zh:
谷歌旗下自动驾驶公司 Waymo 推出了首款专为网约车场景设计的自动驾驶汽车，名为 Ojai。 它还在Waymo中引入了车载AI助手Gemini以及全新的三屏界面。 Waymo 旨在将机舱变成乘客可以独立使用的灵活空间，并将很快邀请更多公众来体验。

双子座上车但不握方向盘，语音交互覆盖客舱

安装在 Ojai 内部的 Waymo 对话式人工智能助手 Gemini 独立于 Waymo Driver 驾驶系统运行。 乘客点击屏幕上的双子座图标后，可以调节空调温度、查看行程信息、询问附近的咖啡店或地标历史，甚至可以通过说出“将空调设置为18摄氏度”来直接控制客舱。 乘客还可以通过语音请求靠边停车，但 Waymo 明确表示，Gemini 不控制车辆移动或路线，也无法访问实时驾驶数据。

此次屏幕更新是 Waymo 多年来所做的首次重大界面更改。 新界面突出显示了行程信息、音乐控制和机舱媒体设置。 Ojai 配备三个屏幕，系统根据座位显示不同的内容——单独坐在右后座的乘客可以访问完整的控制选项，而其他屏幕则显示简化的行程状态或环境媒体播放器。 它还提供平静模式，使屏幕变暗以仅保留最少的行程信息。 从定制硬件到人工智能座舱，再到基于场景的交互，Waymo 正在尝试重新定义“乘坐汽车”的含义——将方向盘交给算法，将其余空间归还给乘客。
